title: Digital Assets Inventory
description: List your online accounts, devices, and digital property so the people you trust can access, save, or close them.
intro: Photos, email, and online accounts can be lost forever if no one knows they exist. List each account and what you want done with it. Do not write passwords on this sheet; note where they are stored instead, such as a password manager.

sections.heading: Devices
items: List each phone, tablet, and computer and where it is kept
Note where device passcodes are stored
List external hard drives and USB backups
Note any smart home hubs or security systems with accounts

sections.heading: Email and communication
items: List each email address and provider
Note which email is used for password resets
List messaging apps with important history
Note any account legacy or inactive account settings you have turned on

sections.heading: Financial and money apps
items: List online banking and investment logins by institution
List payment apps such as PayPal or Venmo
List cryptocurrency exchanges and wallets
Note where hardware wallets and recovery phrases are stored
List online businesses, stores, or income accounts

sections.heading: Photos, files, and social media
items: List cloud storage accounts for photos and documents
List each social media account
Note whether each social account should be memorialized, downloaded, or deleted
List domain names, websites, and blogs with renewal dates

sections.heading: Subscriptions and loyalty
items: List streaming and other recurring subscriptions to cancel
List airline miles, hotel points, and other rewards programs
List any online accounts that hold store credit or gift cards
Note which subscriptions should transfer to a family member instead of being cancelled

sections.heading: Access and instructions
items: Name the person you want to handle your digital accounts
Note the password manager you use and how its emergency access works
Confirm your will or power of attorney grants authority over digital assets
Review this list once a year
